Name: Obtain achievements
Author: abelsdf
Description:
1.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F10 获取新增的9个成就。如果你使用了这个无需再使用下面的指令. Use the shortcut keys LeftShift + F10 obtain 9 new achievements added in version 1.6，If you use this, there is no need to use the following command again

2.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F1 获取博览群书成就。Use the shortcut keys LeftShift + F1 to obtain Well-Read achievements

3.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F2 获取意犹未尽成就。Use the shortcut keys  LeftShift + F2  to obtain Two Thumbs UP achievements

4.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F3 获取冠军成就。Use the shortcut keys  LeftShift + F3  to obtain Blue Ribbon achievements

5.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F4 获取难忘的汤成就。Use the shortcut keys  LeftShift + F4  to obtain An Unforgettable Soup achievements

6.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F5 获取热心邻居成就。Use the shortcut keys  LeftShift + F5  to obtain Good Neighbors achievements

7.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F6 获取遥远的海岸成就。Use the shortcut keys  LeftShift + F6 to obtain A Distant Shore achievements

8.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F7 深处的危险成就。Use the shortcut keys  LeftShift + F7  to obtain Danger In The Deep achievements

9.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F8 获取无限力量成就。Use the shortcut keys  LeftShift + F8  to obtain Infinite Power achievements

10.使用快捷键 LeftShift + F9 获取完美成就。Use the shortcut keys  LeftShift + F9  to obtain Perfection achievements
